findings.rootCause: (b2) Planner-time storage reads took nested reader leases on the query thread, which already holds two dataset leases. develop's TxnManager admits 127 ordinary leases plus 1 reserved slot, with a 30 s admission timeout. Under pool pressure, planning stalled at each nested site and the estimate was silently lost.
findings.change:
No production change in bR. Every critique item was checked against the code in the tree.
- major#2 (read-lock discipline): raw-handle reads go only through planningRead/planningScan callbacks, which run under lockManager.readLock(). That covers sampleTriplesStratified, indexCostProfile, the page estimator, the legacy sampler and boundedExactCardinality. A bare planningReadTxn() is taken only on getTriples/LmdbRecordIterator paths.
- major#3 (Mode.RESET reuse): Txn.isLive(leaseId) checks owned && !closed && !idle && same lease, under the Txn monitor. livePinnedPlanningTxn re-checks it on every use. The pin is structurally nested in the LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.optimize try-with-resources.
- major#4 (untracked snapshots): pinPlanningTxn refuses untracked txns, so LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh stays unpinned.
- major#5 (attribution): LmdbPlannerReaderLeaseTest runs in default and OFF mode and asserts the TxnManager admission counters.
- minor (sail-base anchors): SailDatasetImpl.unwrap is documented as committed-base-only.
- minor#9 (bypassing entry points): unpinned short reads fall back to doWithPriority and scans to one ordinary lease. Owner-thread telemetry is a follow-up.
- missedFinding #2 (union double lease) and #3 (permit baseline): documented only.
All WP classes were re-run green on the final tree.

findings.rootCause:
(b1) LmdbPackedCostModel stamped every finite_binding_probe row DATABASE_EXACT, but planningCardinality discarded the page estimator's exact and hard-bound fields. The consequence is S3 (critique major#1 accepted): a wrong plannedFrontierGuarantee=database_exact planned metric, which also makes LmdbOperatorFeedbackStats freeze row learning.
(bR, critique minor) The probe counts the explicit and inferred planes together. The plan, however, is shared by explicit-only and inferred-including queries: the plan version mixes only the store-level mayHaveInferred flag, and the estimator carries no query-level includeInferred. So on a store with inferred rows, an exact both-plane count is only an upper bound for an explicit-only query, yet it was still labelled database_exact.
findings.change:
b1 fix unchanged: the label follows the aggregated probe evidence (DATABASE_EXACT / CERTIFIED_BOUND_ONLY / SCALAR_FALLBACK), plus plannedFiniteProbeExact and the certified bounds.

bR (TDD) closes the critique's includeInferred minor at the only layer where it can be done soundly. In LmdbPackedCostModel.finiteLookupEstimate, when rows > 0 and runtime.mayHaveInferred():
- exact becomes false
- the certified lower bound becomes 0
- the upper bound becomes max(rows, upper)
The label is then CERTIFIED_BOUND_ONLY with plannedFrontierLowerRows=0 and plannedFrontierUpperRows=both-plane count. A zero over both planes stays DATABASE_EXACT, because it is exact for every plane subset.

This is consistent with the plan cache, whose version already mixes mayHaveInferred. It only weakens the label (so LEO learning is admitted); row estimates and costs are unchanged.

Critique suggestion (2), that LEO admits corrections for a non-exact probe, is covered by the existing LmdbOperatorFeedbackStatsTest#frontierLearningUsesStableKeysAndIndependentDimensionPosteriors (wp6 territory).

Deviation from the critique: it suggested using query-level includeInferred. That would also require includeInferred in the wp3 plan-cache key, otherwise a cached DATABASE_EXACT label could be served to an explicit-only query. So the store-level conservative rule was chosen.

Critique reconciliation:
- major#1-#5: handled (see the findings).
- minor 3.10.1b (estimateExact): handled.
- minor includeInferred: handled conservatively at store level in bR (TDD).
- minor sail-base anchors: handled.
- minor#9: partially handled (develop-style fallbacks, no owner-thread telemetry).
- missedFinding#1: handled.
- missedFindings #2 (union double lease) and #3 (untracked/openPinnedTxn permit baseline): documented, not changed.
wp3: query-level includeInferred could restore DATABASE_EXACT for inferred-including queries on inferencing stores. That only works if includeInferred becomes part of the plan-cache key.
wp6: finite probes on stores with inferred rows now publish certified_bound_only, so LEO row learning is admitted for them.

Static review of the cumulative diff: no System.out, printStackTrace, TODO/FIXME, wildcard imports or commented-out code; no added line over 120 columns; tab indentation. All 7 new files carry the 2026 EDL header plus '// Some portions generated by Claude'.
The build's spotless:apply reformats sources during mvnf runs; the staged tree is the formatted one.

Optional: owner-thread tagging of ordinary TxnManager admissions (critique minor#9).
Optional (wp3 and wp8 together): plumb query-level includeInferred into the estimator and the plan-cache key.
